title: Operation request
description: POST /operations/{name}. One invocation; the name is repeated in the body because the signature covers the body. The add-on decodes it strictly. Request identity: identity/operation.json.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 2: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

call_id.description: The deduplication token. Required, except that a preview (preview: true) carries none.

params.description: Names and secrecy are in registry/operations.json.

preview.description: Feature calls. Return the would-be result with no effect; never recorded.

fresh.description: Feature freshness. Read the app now (an effect read operation only).
